name: 2026-11-12-close.md
text:
# Close wrap, Thu 2026-11-12

**Indexes:** S&P 500 −0.34% to 7,593.39, Nasdaq −0.40% to 25,363.75, Dow −0.36% to 52,296.20 (preliminary). Early losses near 1% were mostly recovered ([Reuters via Devdiscourse](https://www.devdiscourse.com/article/international/4006182-us-stocks-equities-close-lower-as-nvidia-drop-outweighs-energy-gains); [AP](https://apnews.com/article/wall-street-stocks-dow-nasdaq-3f3668a937a11535103e3a5c8d82c9fc)).

**Why:** Jensen Huang resigned and CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO. NVDA was down nearly 12% at the low and closed about 4% lower; retail bought a record ~$111M of NVDA at the open (Vanda, per Reuters). The SOX fell after a 17.2% four-day run. NBIS, CRWV, IREN, APLD, INTC and MU fell, while AVGO, AMD, GOOGL and AMZN rose. Energy led the sectors for a 4th day as crude rose after Trump said no Iran deal is needed. The 10-yr stayed above 5% ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-sp-500-nasdaq-fall-as-nvidia-ceo-exit-rising-bond-yields-roil-markets-195710154.html)).

**Covered names:** LLY closed at $1,427.28 (−0.7%) after opening at $1,446.55, so the China-approval gain faded. TTEK closed at $39.43 (+4.8%) after opening at $41.50, so the gap faded and we did not log it ([Yahoo LLY](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/LLY/history/); [Yahoo TTEK](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/TTEK/history/)).

**After hours:** CSCO was up about 5%. Adj EPS was $1.40 vs $1.33 est. and revenue $18.5B vs $18.1B est. FQ2 guidance is $18.0–18.2B revenue and $1.34–1.36 EPS, and the AI hyperscaler revenue target is now $9B ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/cisco-csco-q1-2027-earnings.html)). AMAT adj EPS was $4.16 vs $4.06 and revenue $10.4B, with FQ1 guidance of $11.1B ±$0.5B. Shares were mixed (+1.4% early, then slipped) ([Seeking Alpha](https://seekingalpha.com/news/4671636-applied-materials-perks-up-on-strong-q4-results-guidance); [TipRanks](https://www.tipranks.com/news/applied-materials-stock-amat-slips-despite-topping-estimates)).

**Tomorrow:** October PPI at 8:30 AM ET. The AI-hardware avoid stays through NVDA earnings on 11/17 AMC. Avoids that expired today are dropped.

**Swing idea (long-only):**
- **CSCO**: a beat and raise with an AI-networking upgrade. Conditional: log it only at Fri 11/13 close if the after-hours gain (~5%) holds, per the gap rule. Its group avoid expires 11/13. Confidence low. Key risk: AI-hardware sentiment after Huang's exit, plus a hot PPI with the 10-yr above 5%.
- No other new longs. LLY is a hold, not a re-add.
